items.question: Trong câu "A recursive function is a function that calls itself.", từ "recursive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A recursive function is a function that calls itself.", what does "recursive" (adjective) mean?
options: đệ quy, tự gọi lại chính nó
items.explanation: recursive /rɪˈkɜːsɪv/ (tính từ): đệ quy, tự gọi lại chính nó. "Recursive function" = hàm đệ quy; danh từ là "recursion".
items.explanationEn: recursive /rɪˈkɜːsɪv/ (adjective): calling itself again. "Recursive function" is a fixed term; the noun is "recursion".

items.question: Trong câu "Instead of solving the whole problem at once, it solves a tiny piece and hands a smaller version of the same problem to another call of itself.", từ "at once" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Instead of solving the whole problem at once, it solves a tiny piece and hands a smaller version of the same problem to another call of itself.", what does "at once" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at once /ət wʌns/ (cụm từ): cùng một lúc, một lần. "At once" có hai nghĩa: "cùng một lúc" (như ở đây) và "ngay lập tức".
items.explanationEn: at once /ət wʌns/ (phrase): all together, in one go. "At once" has two senses: "all together" (as here) and "immediately".

items.question: Trong câu "Instead of solving the whole problem at once, it solves a tiny piece and hands a smaller version of the same problem to another call of itself.", từ "tiny" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Instead of solving the whole problem at once, it solves a tiny piece and hands a smaller version of the same problem to another call of itself.", what does "tiny" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: tiny /ˈtaɪni/ (tính từ): rất nhỏ, bé xíu. "A tiny piece" = một mảnh rất nhỏ; mạnh hơn "small".
items.explanationEn: tiny /ˈtaɪni/ (adjective): very small. "A tiny piece" means a very small part; stronger than "small".

items.question: Trong câu "Martin just used recursion: shrink the problem, stop at a trivial case, and build the answer on the way back.", từ "shrink" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Martin just used recursion: shrink the problem, stop at a trivial case, and build the answer on the way back.", what does "shrink" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shrink /ʃrɪŋk/ (động từ): thu nhỏ, làm co lại. "Shrink the problem" = thu nhỏ bài toán; quá khứ: shrank, shrunk.
items.explanationEn: shrink /ʃrɪŋk/ (verb): to make smaller. "Shrink the problem" means make it smaller; past forms: shrank, shrunk.

items.question: Trong câu "Martin just used recursion: shrink the problem, stop at a trivial case, and build the answer on the way back.", từ "trivial" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Martin just used recursion: shrink the problem, stop at a trivial case, and build the answer on the way back.", what does "trivial" (adjective) mean?
options: hiển nhiên, cực kỳ đơn giản
items.explanation: trivial /ˈtrɪviəl/ (tính từ): hiển nhiên, cực kỳ đơn giản. "A trivial case" = trường hợp hiển nhiên, giải được ngay mà không cần tính toán.
items.explanationEn: trivial /ˈtrɪviəl/ (adjective): obvious, extremely simple. "A trivial case" is one you can answer immediately without real work.

items.question: Trong câu "Any self-similar data: folders inside folders, comments with replies, nested arrays.", từ "self-similar" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Any self-similar data: folders inside folders, comments with replies, nested arrays.", what does "self-similar" (adjective) mean?
options: tự đồng dạng, lặp cấu trúc
items.explanation: self-similar /ˌself ˈsɪmələ(r)/ (tính từ): tự đồng dạng, lặp cấu trúc. "Self-similar data" = dữ liệu mà phần nhỏ có cùng cấu trúc với phần lớn, ví dụ thư mục trong thư mục.
items.explanationEn: self-similar /ˌself ˈsɪmələ(r)/ (adjective): repeating its own shape inside. "Self-similar data" has parts shaped like the whole, e.g. folders inside folders.

items.question: Trong câu "For such problems recursion is often a cleaner alternative to a loop.", từ "alternative" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For such problems recursion is often a cleaner alternative to a loop.", what does "alternative" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: alternative /ɔːlˈtɜːnətɪv/ (danh từ): lựa chọn thay thế. "An alternative to X" = một lựa chọn thay cho X.
items.explanationEn: alternative /ɔːlˈtɜːnətɪv/ (noun): another possible choice. "An alternative to X" is another option you can use instead of X.

items.question: Trong câu "To understand recursion you must understand the call stack, the structure the JavaScript engine uses to track which functions are running.", từ "track" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To understand recursion you must understand the call stack, the structure the JavaScript engine uses to track which functions are running.", what does "track" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: track /træk/ (động từ): theo dõi, ghi nhận. "Track" (động từ) = theo dõi; cụm hay gặp "keep track of".
items.explanationEn: track /træk/ (verb): to follow and record. "Track" (verb) means to follow and record; common phrase: "keep track of".

items.question: Trong câu "To understand recursion you must understand the call stack, the structure the JavaScript engine uses to track which functions are running.", từ "engine" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To understand recursion you must understand the call stack, the structure the JavaScript engine uses to track which functions are running.", what does "engine" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: engine /ˈendʒɪn/ (danh từ): bộ máy thực thi (phần mềm). "JavaScript engine" (V8, SpiderMonkey...) = phần mềm đọc và chạy mã JS.
items.explanationEn: engine /ˈendʒɪn/ (noun): software that runs code. A "JavaScript engine" (V8, SpiderMonkey...) is the program that runs JS code.

items.question: Trong câu "Calling a function pushes a frame (its arguments, local variables and where to resume) onto the top of the stack.", từ "frame" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Calling a function pushes a frame (its arguments, local variables and where to resume) onto the top of the stack.", what does "frame" (noun) mean?
options: khung lưu một lời gọi hàm
optionsEn: a record for one function call
items.explanation: frame /freɪm/ (danh từ): khung lưu một lời gọi hàm. "Stack frame" = khung ngăn xếp chứa tham số, biến cục bộ và vị trí quay lại.
items.explanationEn: frame /freɪm/ (noun): a record for one function call. A "stack frame" holds a call's arguments, locals and return point.

items.question: Trong câu "When a function hits return (or its closing brace), its frame is popped, and execution resumes in the frame below.", từ "resume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a function hits return (or its closing brace), its frame is popped, and execution resumes in the frame below.", what does "resume" (verb) mean?
options: tiếp tục lại sau khi dừng
items.explanation: resume /rɪˈzjuːm/ (động từ): tiếp tục lại sau khi dừng. "Execution resumes" = việc chạy tiếp tục lại tại chỗ đã dừng; khác với danh từ "résumé" (sơ yếu lý lịch).
items.explanationEn: resume /rɪˈzjuːm/ (verb): to continue after a pause. "Execution resumes" means it continues where it paused; unrelated to the noun "résumé".

items.question: Trong câu "When a function hits return (or its closing brace), its frame is popped, and execution resumes in the frame below.", từ "execution" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a function hits return (or its closing brace), its frame is popped, and execution resumes in the frame below.", what does "execution" (noun) mean?
options: sự thực thi, việc chạy mã
items.explanation: execution /ˌeksɪˈkjuːʃn/ (danh từ): sự thực thi, việc chạy mã. Trong lập trình, "execution" = việc chạy chương trình; động từ là "execute".
items.explanationEn: execution /ˌeksɪˈkjuːʃn/ (noun): the running of code. In programming "execution" is running a program; the verb is "execute".

items.question: Trong câu "Only the top frame is running; every frame below is paused, waiting.", từ "pause" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Only the top frame is running; every frame below is paused, waiting.", what does "pause" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: pause /pɔːz/ (động từ): tạm dừng. "Be paused" = đang bị tạm dừng, sẽ chạy tiếp sau.
items.explanationEn: pause /pɔːz/ (verb): to stop for a while. "Be paused" means stopped for now and continuing later.

items.question: Trong câu "A base case, the condition where the recursion ends and returns without calling itself again.", từ "condition" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A base case, the condition where the recursion ends and returns without calling itself again.", what does "condition" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a rule that must be true
items.explanation: condition /kənˈdɪʃn/ (danh từ): điều kiện. "Condition" ở đây là điều kiện logic; "in good condition" lại là "tình trạng tốt".
items.explanationEn: condition /kənˈdɪʃn/ (noun): a rule that must be true. Here "condition" is a logical rule; "in good condition" means a good state.

items.question: Trong câu "Note the base case uses num <= 0, not num === 0: a defensive base case also stops for inputs like -5 or 2.5 that would jump past an exact match.", từ "defensive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Note the base case uses num <= 0, not num === 0: a defensive base case also stops for inputs like -5 or 2.5 that would jump past an exact match.", what does "defensive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: defensive /dɪˈfensɪv/ (tính từ): phòng thủ, đề phòng lỗi. "Defensive programming" = viết mã đề phòng cả những đầu vào không mong đợi.
items.explanationEn: defensive /dɪˈfensɪv/ (adjective): guarding against errors. "Defensive programming" means coding to survive unexpected inputs.

items.question: Trong câu "Note the base case uses num <= 0, not num === 0: a defensive base case also stops for inputs like -5 or 2.5 that would jump past an exact match.", từ "match" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Note the base case uses num <= 0, not num === 0: a defensive base case also stops for inputs like -5 or 2.5 that would jump past an exact match.", what does "match" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: match /mætʃ/ (danh từ): sự trùng khớp. "An exact match" = trùng khớp chính xác; "match" còn nghĩa trận đấu, que diêm.
items.explanationEn: match /mætʃ/ (noun): a case of being equal. "An exact match" means exactly equal; "match" can also be a game or a matchstick.

items.question: Trong câu "You can watch this live in the Sources panel of Chrome DevTools: set a breakpoint inside a recursive function and read the "Call Stack" list.", từ "breakpoint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You can watch this live in the Sources panel of Chrome DevTools: set a breakpoint inside a recursive function and read the "Call Stack" list.", what does "breakpoint" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: breakpoint /ˈbreɪkpɔɪnt/ (danh từ): điểm dừng khi gỡ lỗi. "Set a breakpoint" = đặt điểm dừng để trình gỡ lỗi dừng tại dòng đó.
items.explanationEn: breakpoint /ˈbreɪkpɔɪnt/ (noun): a debugger pause point. "Set a breakpoint" means mark a line where the debugger pauses.

items.question: Trong câu "Most recursive functions compute a value, and each call must return its result to the caller below it on the stack.", từ "compute" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most recursive functions compute a value, and each call must return its result to the caller below it on the stack.", what does "compute" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: compute /kəmˈpjuːt/ (động từ): tính toán ra. "Compute a value" = tính ra một giá trị; danh từ "computation".
items.explanationEn: compute /kəmˈpjuːt/ (verb): to calculate. "Compute a value" means calculate it; the noun is "computation".

items.question: Trong câu "Most recursive functions compute a value, and each call must return its result to the caller below it on the stack.", từ "caller" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most recursive functions compute a value, and each call must return its result to the caller below it on the stack.", what does "caller" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a person making a phone call
the code that called a function
items.explanation: caller /ˈkɔːlə(r)/ (danh từ): nơi gọi hàm. "Caller" = đoạn mã gọi hàm; ngược lại là "callee" (hàm được gọi).
items.explanationEn: caller /ˈkɔːlə(r)/ (noun): the code that called a function. The "caller" invokes a function; the invoked one is the "callee".

items.question: Trong câu "sumRange(4) has to wait for sumRange(3), which waits for sumRange(2), and so on.", từ "and so on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "sumRange(4) has to wait for sumRange(3), which waits for sumRange(2), and so on.", what does "and so on" (phrase) mean?
options: vân vân, cứ thế tiếp tục
items.explanation: and so on /ənd ˈsəʊ ɒn/ (cụm từ): vân vân, cứ thế tiếp tục. "And so on" đặt cuối liệt kê để nói mẫu còn tiếp diễn, giống "etc.".
items.explanationEn: and so on /ənd ˈsəʊ ɒn/ (phrase): and continuing the same way. "And so on" ends a list to say the pattern continues, like "etc.".

items.question: Trong câu "If you wrote num + sumRange(num - 1); without return, every call except the base case would return undefined, and sumRange(4) would give undefined even though all the recursive calls ran.", từ "except" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you wrote num + sumRange(num - 1); without return, every call except the base case would return undefined, and sumRange(4) would give undefined even though all the recursive calls ran.", what does "except" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: except /ɪkˈsept/ (giới từ): ngoại trừ. "Every X except Y" = mọi X trừ Y.
items.explanationEn: except /ɪkˈsept/ (preposition): apart from. "Every X except Y" means all X but not Y.

items.question: Trong câu "If you wrote num + sumRange(num - 1); without return, every call except the base case would return undefined, and sumRange(4) would give undefined even though all the recursive calls ran.", từ "even though" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you wrote num + sumRange(num - 1); without return, every call except the base case would return undefined, and sumRange(4) would give undefined even though all the recursive calls ran.", what does "even though" (conjunction) mean?
items.explanation: even though /ˈiːvn ðəʊ/ (liên từ): mặc dù. "Even though" nối hai ý trái ngược: kết quả là undefined mặc dù các lời gọi đều đã chạy.
items.explanationEn: even though /ˈiːvn ðəʊ/ (conjunction): despite the fact that. "Even though" links contrasting ideas: undefined despite all calls running.

items.question: Trong câu "The recursive definition is n! = n × (n-1)! with 1! = 1 (and 0! = 1).", từ "definition" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The recursive definition is n! = n × (n-1)! with 1! = 1 (and 0! = 1).", what does "definition" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: definition /ˌdefɪˈnɪʃn/ (danh từ): định nghĩa. "Recursive definition" = định nghĩa một thứ dựa trên chính nó ở kích thước nhỏ hơn.
items.explanationEn: definition /ˌdefɪˈnɪʃn/ (noun): a statement of meaning. A "recursive definition" defines something in terms of a smaller version of itself.

items.question: Trong câu "That number, the maximum recursion depth, is exactly what determines a recursive function's memory use.", từ "determine" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That number, the maximum recursion depth, is exactly what determines a recursive function's memory use.", what does "determine" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: determine /dɪˈtɜːmɪn/ (động từ): quyết định, xác định. "X determines Y" = X quyết định Y; ở đây độ sâu quyết định lượng bộ nhớ.
items.explanationEn: determine /dɪˈtɜːmɪn/ (verb): to decide or fix. "X determines Y" means X decides Y; here depth decides memory use.

items.question: Trong câu "That number, the maximum recursion depth, is exactly what determines a recursive function's memory use.", từ "depth" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That number, the maximum recursion depth, is exactly what determines a recursive function's memory use.", what does "depth" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: depth /depθ/ (danh từ): độ sâu (số tầng lồng nhau). "Recursion depth" = số khung đang mở cùng lúc; tính từ là "deep".
items.explanationEn: depth /depθ/ (noun): how many levels deep. "Recursion depth" is how many frames are open at once; adjective: "deep".

items.question: Trong câu "The input never gets smaller, so the base case is never reached.", từ "reach" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The input never gets smaller, so the base case is never reached.", what does "reach" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reach /riːtʃ/ (động từ): đạt tới, chạm tới. "Reach the base case" = chạm tới trường hợp cơ sở.
items.explanationEn: reach /riːtʃ/ (verb): to arrive at. "Reach the base case" means arrive at it.

items.question: Trong câu "The same happens with a correct num - 1 step but an unreachable check: factorial(0) with if (num === 1) goes 0, -1, -2, … forever.", từ "unreachable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The same happens with a correct num - 1 step but an unreachable check: factorial(0) with if (num === 1) goes 0, -1, -2, … forever.", what does "unreachable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unreachable /ʌnˈriːtʃəbl/ (tính từ): không thể chạm tới. Tiền tố "un-" + "reach" + "-able": không thể tới được.
items.explanationEn: unreachable /ʌnˈriːtʃəbl/ (adjective): impossible to arrive at. "un-" + "reach" + "-able": cannot be arrived at.

items.question: Trong câu "The same happens with a correct num - 1 step but an unreachable check: factorial(0) with if (num === 1) goes 0, -1, -2, … forever.", từ "forever" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The same happens with a correct num - 1 step but an unreachable check: factorial(0) with if (num === 1) goes 0, -1, -2, … forever.", what does "forever" (adverb) mean?
options: mãi mãi, không bao giờ dừng
items.explanation: forever /fərˈevə(r)/ (trạng từ): mãi mãi, không bao giờ dừng. "Go on forever" = chạy mãi không dừng, dấu hiệu của đệ quy vô hạn.
items.explanationEn: forever /fərˈevə(r)/ (adverb): without ever ending. "Go on forever" means never stopping, a sign of infinite recursion.

items.question: Trong câu "The base case prints but does not stop, so the calls continue into negative numbers.", từ "negative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The base case prints but does not stop, so the calls continue into negative numbers.", what does "negative" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: negative /ˈneɡətɪv/ (tính từ): âm (nhỏ hơn 0). "Negative numbers" = số âm; "negative" còn nghĩa tiêu cực.
items.explanationEn: negative /ˈneɡətɪv/ (adjective): less than zero. "Negative numbers" are below zero; "negative" can also mean pessimistic.

items.question: Trong câu "Every frame costs memory, and the engine caps the stack size (typically around ten thousand frames, depending on the engine and frame size).", từ "cap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every frame costs memory, and the engine caps the stack size (typically around ten thousand frames, depending on the engine and frame size).", what does "cap" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: cap /kæp/ (động từ): đặt mức tối đa. "Cap the size" = giới hạn kích thước tối đa; danh từ "cap" còn là mũ, nắp.
items.explanationEn: cap /kæp/ (verb): to set an upper limit. "Cap the size" means set a maximum; the noun "cap" is also a hat or lid.

items.question: Trong câu "Every frame costs memory, and the engine caps the stack size (typically around ten thousand frames, depending on the engine and frame size).", từ "typically" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every frame costs memory, and the engine caps the stack size (typically around ten thousand frames, depending on the engine and frame size).", what does "typically" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: typically /ˈtɪpɪkli/ (trạng từ): thường thì, điển hình. "Typically around X" = thường vào khoảng X.
items.explanationEn: typically /ˈtɪpɪkli/ (adverb): usually, in most cases. "Typically around X" means usually about X.

items.question: Trong câu "Every frame costs memory, and the engine caps the stack size (typically around ten thousand frames, depending on the engine and frame size).", từ "depending on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every frame costs memory, and the engine caps the stack size (typically around ten thousand frames, depending on the engine and frame size).", what does "depending on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: depending on /dɪˈpendɪŋ ɒn/ (cụm từ): tùy thuộc vào. "Depending on X" = tùy vào X; trái nghĩa "regardless of".
items.explanationEn: depending on /dɪˈpendɪŋ ɒn/ (phrase): varying with. "Depending on X" means it varies with X; opposite: "regardless of".

items.question: Trong câu "Exceed it and JavaScript throws:", từ "exceed" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Exceed it and JavaScript throws:", what does "exceed" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: exceed /ɪkˈsiːd/ (động từ): vượt quá. "Exceed the limit" = vượt quá giới hạn; thông báo lỗi dùng "exceeded".
items.explanationEn: exceed /ɪkˈsiːd/ (verb): to go beyond. "Exceed the limit" means go past it; the error message says "exceeded".

items.question: Trong câu "A stack overflow can also happen with correct code if the input is simply too deep, e.g. sumRange(1_000_000).", từ "overflow" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A stack overflow can also happen with correct code if the input is simply too deep, e.g. sumRange(1_000_000).", what does "overflow" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: overflow /ˈəʊvəfləʊ/ (danh từ): sự tràn (vượt sức chứa). "Stack overflow" = tràn ngăn xếp khi có quá nhiều khung.
items.explanationEn: overflow /ˈəʊvəfləʊ/ (noun): going past capacity. "Stack overflow" happens when there are too many frames for the stack.

items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not rely on tail call optimization in production JavaScript: if the depth can be large, convert to a loop.", what does "rely on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rely on /rɪˈlaɪ ɒn/ (cụm từ): dựa vào, trông cậy. "Rely on X" = trông cậy vào X; tính từ "reliable".
items.explanationEn: rely on /rɪˈlaɪ ɒn/ (phrase): to depend on. "Rely on X" means depend on X; adjective: "reliable".

items.question: Trong câu "Do not rely on tail call optimization in production JavaScript: if the depth can be large, convert to a loop.", từ "convert" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not rely on tail call optimization in production JavaScript: if the depth can be large, convert to a loop.", what does "convert" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: convert /kənˈvɜːt/ (động từ): chuyển đổi. "Convert A to B" = chuyển A thành B.
items.explanationEn: convert /kənˈvɜːt/ (verb): to change into another form. "Convert A to B" means change A into the form B.

items.question: Trong câu "A recursive function needs a base case and a different input that moves toward it; say both out loud before coding.", từ "out loud" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A recursive function needs a base case and a different input that moves toward it; say both out loud before coding.", what does "out loud" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: out loud /aʊt laʊd/ (cụm từ): thành tiếng, nói ra. "Say it out loud" = nói thành tiếng, quan trọng khi phỏng vấn.
items.explanationEn: out loud /aʊt laʊd/ (phrase): aloud, so others hear. "Say it out loud" means speak it aloud, key in interviews.

items.question: Trong câu "Always return the recursive result; a missing return silently yields undefined.", từ "yield" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Always return the recursive result; a missing return silently yields undefined.", what does "yield" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: yield /jiːld/ (động từ): tạo ra, cho ra. "Yields undefined" = cho ra undefined; "yield" còn nghĩa nhường đường.
items.explanationEn: yield /jiːld/ (verb): to produce. "Yields undefined" means produces it; "yield" can also mean give way.

items.question: Trong câu "Recursion solves a problem by solving a smaller instance of the same problem until a trivial base case.", từ "instance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Recursion solves a problem by solving a smaller instance of the same problem until a trivial base case.", what does "instance" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an object made from a class
items.explanation: instance /ˈɪnstəns/ (danh từ): trường hợp, phiên bản. "A smaller instance of the problem" = một trường hợp nhỏ hơn của cùng bài toán.
items.explanationEn: instance /ˈɪnstəns/ (noun): one case of a problem. "A smaller instance of the problem" is a smaller case of the same problem.

items.question: Trong câu "Helper method recursion uses a closure for accumulated results; pure recursion copies inputs instead of mutating them, at a copying cost.", từ "accumulate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Helper method recursion uses a closure for accumulated results; pure recursion copies inputs instead of mutating them, at a copying cost.", what does "accumulate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: accumulate /əˈkjuːmjəleɪt/ (động từ): tích lũy, dồn lại. "Accumulated results" = kết quả được dồn lại qua nhiều lần gọi.
items.explanationEn: accumulate /əˈkjuːmjəleɪt/ (verb): to gather over time. "Accumulated results" are gathered across many calls.

items.question: Trong câu "JavaScript engines mostly lack tail call optimization, so switch to a loop or explicit stack.", từ "lack" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "JavaScript engines mostly lack tail call optimization, so switch to a loop or explicit stack.", what does "lack" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: lack /læk/ (động từ): thiếu, không có. "Lack X" = không có X (không dùng "lack of" sau động từ).
items.explanationEn: lack /læk/ (verb): to be without. "Lack X" means not have X (no "of" after the verb).

items.question: Trong câu "Prefer iteration when depth may be large; tail call optimization is not something JavaScript can count on.", từ "count on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prefer iteration when depth may be large; tail call optimization is not something JavaScript can count on.", what does "count on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: count on /kaʊnt ɒn/ (cụm từ): trông cậy vào. "Count on X" = tin cậy X; đồng nghĩa "rely on".
items.explanationEn: count on /kaʊnt ɒn/ (phrase): to depend on. "Count on X" means depend on X; synonym: "rely on".
